LanguageData.SFGF_Intro: Adjust the facility's power output, fuel capacity and daily fuel consumption. Changes apply immediately to every built facility and are saved when the window closes.
LanguageData.SFGF_Note: Defaults: 7500 W / 400 fuel / 2.22 per day, about 3 years at full fuel (1 year = 60 days). The defaults scale the citadel chemfuel generator by the Milira solar-fuel generator's ratios relative to the vanilla chemfuel generator, then halve the derived capacity to 400; see the README in the mod folder.
